correctness.rationale: From the two one-variable reproducing kernels, restrict the full tensor kernel along (z,e^{iθ}z), then apply the coordinate swap projection P+=(I+U)/2. This yields a diagonal positive kernel with coefficients (c_n(2r)+C_n^(r)(cos θ))/2, normalized by c_n(2r). For θ in (0,π), positivity is strict because adjacent contributing phases differ, while Darboux expansion at e^{±iθ} gives λ_n−1/2=β n^(−r) cos((n+r)θ−πr/2)+O(n^(−r−1)). Rational phases use period classes, irrational phases use Weyl equidistribution; the scaled exceedance count N(t)~β^(1/r) M t^(−1/r) implies ordered s_k~βM^r k^(−r) and Schatten iff p>1/r. Endpoint θ=0 gives identity, θ=π gives even projection, neither centered operator is compact. Independently checked 352 weighted kernel row identities and 79 Hardy identities; for r=1 and θ=π/2 the ordered constant tends to 1/4 (k=500: 0.25025025). Asymptotic requires the analytic two-singularity transfer and counting, not finite tests.
